messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert triggered for hosted-infer.gateway in usw2 — p99 timeouts = 3.4x baseline over last 5m. Alert: SLO-7955-03. Notifying eng-sre and support-ops.

maria: saw a support ticket from Acme — they report intermittent 502/504s and clients timing out. Ticket includes a couple of request_ids. I can share logs.

aj: looking at the dashboard now https://dash.reed/hosted-infer/gateway/usw2 — spike in 5xx + client timeout counts at 16:12 UTC. Quick logs query (stackdriver):
```
resource.type="k8s_container"
logName:"projects/redwood/logs/gateway"
jsonPayload.code >= 500
| timestamp >= "2026-03-17T16:10:00Z"
| jsonPayload.request_id in ("req-A1","req-A2")
```
results show many upstream timeouts to runtime-proxy with code 504.

drew: traces show a sampling gap between ingress and batcher around the same window — spans from gateway -> batcher missing in several traces. suspect batching/kv cache miss causing long tail.

luis: can we confirm token rotation? support ticket mentions 401s earlier this morning but current errors are 5xx. token expiry would be auth layer, not gateway 504s though. I pulled auth logs and nothing obvious since rotation at 02:00 UTC.

maria: tried a local repro against the same model endpoint with a small payload:
```bash
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"small"}' -m 12
```
result: HTTP/1.1 504 after 8s, body: "upstream timed out".

aj: added a metrics overlay — kvcache_evictions per host jumps right at the spike. Also see increased queue_length on batcher pods -> backlog suggests cold cache churn.

drew: that matches. When KV cache thrashes, batcher stalls waiting on prefix lookups, causing head-of-line blocking. If many requests try to fetch cached prefixes and miss, runtime calls upstream model variants, raising p99.

support-ops: impacted customers count = 12 (billing accounts attached: enterprise & pro). Customer tickets: 6 open with active timeouts. Escalating to account team. CC @eng-oncall.

maria: immediate mitigations: 1) enable fallback to smaller q4 model for the canary pool, 2) increase batcher concurrency on usw2 by +20% (hotfix), 3) temporarily bump kvcache TTL to reduce churn. Thoughts?

aj: +1 for kvcache TTL bump and concurrency. Rolling changes to canary first. I can push a quick k8s scale/playbook: `kubectl -n infer scale deployment/batcher --replicas=6` and toggle feature flag `kvcache.ttl.override=60s`.

drew: open an observability ticket to follow up on trace sampling gaps. We should also add a dashboard tile for kvcache_evictions vs gateway_5xx so this doesn't blindside us.

luis: I'll verify auth tokens again and confirm no correlation. If anyone sees 401s reappear, ping me.

support-ops: started a single consolidated support thread for affected customers and added mitigation steps + ETA.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: Started deployment rollout batcher-v2 -> replicas=6 by aj at 16:26:12 UTC.

maria: applying TTL override now, rolling to canary. Will report back in 2–3 mins.

aj: TTL change applied, canary shows immediate drop in evictions. Batch queue length trending down.

drew: traces coming back with full spans — sampling gap reduced. Early sign: p99 timeouts dropping toward baseline.

maria: confirmed with Acme — their requests are succeeding again. Closing support tickets after verifying 30m stable.

support-ops: thanks — keeping customers informed. Please file a follow-up postmortem with RCA and prevention action items.

maria: will start a postmortem doc and include dashboard queries, timeline, and the repro curl command. Assigning postmortem owner: @maria.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert SLO-7955-03 resolved at 16:36 UTC.
